extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: single-seat sailplane (glider), approx. 6.8 m long, 15.0 m wingspan, 1.6 m high when level (2.6 m to the raised wing tip in the tipped resting pose)
extras.notes: nose faces -Y; resting pose as parked on an airfield: stands on the main wheel and the tail wheel and is tipped onto the right wing-tip skid (roll 10.0 degrees), all three contact points at z = 0; main wheel and tail wheel are separate objects with origin on the axle; opaque tinted canopy, no interior; no text, no registration, no brand

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
